title: Diagnosing Siphonage and Vent Blockages
description: Gurgling drains and slow drainage often point directly to a compromised vent system rather than a main line clog. When water flows down a waste pipe without proper airflow, it creates a negative pressure vacuum. This vacuum pulls water out of nearby P-traps, breaking the water seal that keeps sewer gases out of the building. Inspecting roof vent stacks for bird nests, debris, or frost closure is a critical troubleshooting step. Restoring full airflow balances system pressure, protects trap seals, and ensures smooth, consistent drainage throughout the fixture network. Check local plumbing codes for vent terminal sizing and termination height requirements.
